description: This PHP script manages the display and processing of picklist options within the vtiger CRM system, including permission checks, module and role selection, and rendering templates for picklist management.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering views in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrative privileges.

methods.name: vtiger_imageurl
methods.description: Generates the URL for a given image in the vtiger theme.

methods.name: getPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of modules that have picklist fields.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input data to prevent security issues.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language strings for a specified module and language.

methods.name: getUserFldArray
methods.description: Fetches user-specific picklist entries for a module and role.

methods.name: get_available_module_picklist
methods.description: Returns available picklist options for a module.

methods.name: getrole2picklist
methods.description: Retrieves role options for picklist assignment.
